from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
p.write_text('[{"step":1,"file":"src-vul/openthread/tests/fuzz/ip6_send.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":18,"var":"data[0..size-1]","code":"The fuzzer input is appended to a newly created IPv6 message and sent with otIp6Send().","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes become the outbound CoAP/IPv6 payload that drives the vulnerable parser."},{"step":2,"file":"src-vul/openthread/src/core/coap/coap.cpp","function":"CoapBase::ProcessReceivedRequest","line":581,"var":"aMessage","code":"Incoming CoAP request is parsed, URI path options are concatenated, and the matching resource handler is dispatched.","note":"The crafted request reaches the MeshCoP active-set handler through the CoAP request dispatcher."},{"step":3,"file":"src-vul/openthread/src/core/meshcop/dataset_manager_ftd.cpp","function":"ActiveDataset::HandleSet","line":515,"var":"aMessage","code":"Active dataset SET requests are forwarded to DatasetManager::HandleSet().","note":"This is the entry point for processing the attacker-controlled MeshCoP dataset TLVs."},{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/openthread/src/core/meshcop/dataset_manager_ftd.cpp","function":"DatasetManager::HandleSet","line":150,"var":"meshLocalPrefix","code":"Tlv::GetTlv(aMessage, Tlv::kMeshLocalPrefix, sizeof(meshLocalPrefix), meshLocalPrefix) copies the Mesh Local Prefix TLV into a fixed-size stack object and then compares its length bytes with the local prefix using memcmp().","note":"The bug is that memcmp() uses meshLocalPrefix.GetLength() bytes without bounding it to the 8-byte destination/source object size, so an oversized TLV length causes an out-of-bounds read."}]')
PY
bash submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openthread/tests/fuzz/ip6_send.cpp /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true
